question.text: Which of the following is NOT one of the six steps in the financial planning process?

answer.text: Establish and define the client-planner relationship
Execute trades on behalf of the client in the stock market

explanation.text: The Logic: The six steps are: (1) Establish client-planner relationship, (2) Gather client data, (3) Analyse financial status, (4) Develop recommendations, (5) Implement recommendations, (6) Monitor recommendations. Executing stock trades is not a step in the planning process. The Trap: Implementation involves executing the plan, but this refers to completing procedures and paperwork, not directly trading stocks.
